arguments.summary: A critical data exfiltration attempt was detected and thwarted on 2026-04-09. The threat actor compromised user CORP\jsmith via a phishing email leading to a Cobalt Strike beacon execution. Lateral movement to the production SQL server (SRV-SQL-PROD-01) was achieved, where the service account 'svc-sql-prod' was misused to dump 4.2 million customer records. The dump file was staged in /tmp and an outbound SCP transfer to 203.0.113.88 was initiated but blocked by the firewall. The service account has been revoked, and the malicious IP blocked. No data was exfiltrated.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike beacon DLL in memory or on disk"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:AMBER"
    strings:
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" ascii
        $http_post = "POST / HTTP/1.1" ascii
        $beacon_config = { 6A 00 68 [2] 00 00 68 [2] 00 00 E8 [4] 83 C4 0C 85 C0 } // Common config stub
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" ascii
    condition:
        (uint16(0) == 0x5A4D) and (2 of ($http_*) or $beacon_config) and $user_agent
}
